create_silk_torch_script_model: create a torch script model from a SILK model using torch.jit.trace and save it to disk
test_silk_model_consistency: test that a SILK model and its torch script version produce consistent positions and descriptors on image pairs
correct_silk_model_positions: wrap a SILK model to correct feature coordinates to image coordinates using from_feature_coords_to_image_coords
load_silk_image_pair: load two image files into a tensor batch using load_images for SILK model inference
test_silk_script_on_downsampled_images: test a traced SILK torch script model on downsampled images to verify shape flexibility
